material.acceptance_criteria: mod-host exports one table of every global and event name, mod-lsp builds completion and hover from that table, and CI fails when a registered global is missing from LSP completion.
material.description: rust/crates/mod-lsp/src/main.rs HOST_GLOBALS lists define_region, in_region, on_tick and state. mod-host registers about 25 globals in bind_host (spawn_unit, order_unit, damage_unit, schedule, cancel, edit_terrain, set_tile, place_doodad, buff_unit, list_abilities and others) plus the five EVENTS, and exports none of them as data. CI checks only three names, so the LSP cannot offer most host globals.
material.resolution: One source for host globals: mod-host exports HOST_GLOBALS (24) and EVENTS (5); compile_src refuses a load when the two disagree; mod-lsp completion and hover use the export; CI checks completion equals the export and prints the count.
material.subject: Mod LSP completion and hover list four host globals from a hand-kept table
material.witness: ci-status for cb054d358803b27b5c094a7ae2405367c0f9c787 (run 38900942619 wasip2 job green)
material.witness_plan: CI step: a test in mod-host enumerates the exported table and asserts each name is registered on the mod env; the mod-lsp job asserts completion labels equal the exported table.
